answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 24951 Country: Pakistan Title: I want to know is it allowed for muslim males to wear platinum ring which has silver plating? Question: Assalamoalaikum mufti sahab, I want to know is it allowed for muslim males to wear platinum ring which has silver plating? JazakAllah khair Answer ID: 24951 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1312/1035/D=1431) If the silver is plated in a way that the interior metal is not shown, it is allowed to wear such a ring. قال فى الشامية لا باس بان يتخد خاتم حديد قد لوي عليه فضة والبس بفضة حتى لا يرى (تاترخانية) شامى ج:5 ، ص:257) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
